title: Bag of Bricks - Toffee 29
descriptionHtml:
Toffee — colour 29

A warm mid-brown that sits neatly between Caramel and Coffee. That makes it the blending brick for smooth transitions across skin, fur and wood grain.

Works well with: Caramel 15, Coffee 14, Brown 12

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Toffee bricks (colour 29) for Memobrick mosaics. A warm mid-brown that sits beautifully between caramel and coffee for smooth shading.
